title: Appeals and Grievances: Questions on the Inpatient Cost Share for Days Carried to a Second Level
content:
## Appeals and Grievances: questions on the inpatient cost share for the days carried

Scope: a second-level reconsideration asked for on a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration of an inpatient mental health authorization.

**Rule.** The cost share on the days carried is figured by the tier's inpatient basis for a facility of that network status: under a percentage-of-allowed basis it is the cost-share percentage of the amount it is figured on; under a lesser-of basis it is the smaller of the daily inpatient charge for each day and the cost-share percentage of the amount it is figured on; under a per-admission basis it is the tier's admission copayment; under any other basis it is the daily inpatient charge for each day, never less than the tier's minimum inpatient charge; it is rounded to the cent.

The basis read is the tier's network inpatient basis for a facility recorded as network and its non-network inpatient basis for a facility recorded as non-network; the daily inpatient charge is likewise the tier's network or non-network daily inpatient charge by that status. The minimum inpatient charge is the tier's minimum inpatient charge and the admission copayment is the tier's inpatient admission copayment — the minimum charge and the admission copayment shown in the tier's network inpatient schedule, whatever the facility's status — as set in the TRICARE Select schedule of the tier the stay is billed under. The days are the days carried.

*The tier's basis for the facility's status is a daily charge with a minimum, the daily charge is a hypothetical 250.00 and there are 5 days. The cost share?* 1,250.00, the daily charge for each of the 5 days, which is above any minimum of 25.00.

*Same tier, 1 day at a daily charge of 20.00, minimum 25.00?* 25.00 — never less than the minimum inpatient charge.

*The basis is the lesser of a daily charge and a percentage: 250.00 a day for 5 days against 20 percent of 4,250.00?* The smaller of 1,250.00 and 850.00, so 850.00.

*The basis is a per-admission copayment of 200.00?* 200.00, whatever the number of days.
